name: Bound to Please
source:
A young man who left for college, leaving his best childhood friends behind. He promised he would keep in contact. But as he started a new life, his relationships with his childhood friends weaken. He has a girlfriend now and new friends, but one day after some time has pass, one of his childhood friends went to go visit and stay with him for a while. Drama is coming too.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/VocalGames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人离开了他最好的儿时朋友，离开了大学。他承诺会保持联系。但当他开始新的生活时，他与儿时朋友的关系减弱了。他现在有了女朋友，也有了新朋友，但过了一段时间后的一天，他儿时的一个朋友去看望他，并在他身边住了一段时间。剧情也来了。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/VocalGames]Patreon[/url]]
